panelTabFeatures.description: Panel tab that lists the features of the site being viewed

panelTabSites.description: Panel tab that lists the sites Voyager can reach

panelTabCreate.description: Panel tab where the user asks the page's AI to write a plugin (Create mode)

panelCreateIntro.message: Say what should change on this site. The AI here writes a plugin for it, and Voyager offers to install it from the reply.
panelCreateIntro.description: Create tab: what Create mode does, above the request field

panelCreateUnsupported.message: Create mode doesn’t run on this website yet.
panelCreateUnsupported.description: Create tab on a website where Create mode does not run

panelCreateHint.message: Create on this page opens a new chat here with your request in the message box. Read it, then send it yourself.
panelCreateHint.description: Create tab: what the Create on this page button does; nothing is sent

panelCreateOnPage.description: Create tab button: open a new chat on this page with the creation message

panelCreateWeakModel.description: Create tab warning title: {site} is the chat site (Gemini), {model} the model it shows (Flash), which usually cannot write a plugin

panelCreateWeakModelThinking.message: {site}’s {model} with {thinking} thinking usually can’t write a plugin.
panelCreateWeakModelThinking.description: Create tab warning title with the thinking level: {site} the chat site, {model} the model, {thinking} its thinking level as the site names it (Low)

panelCreateWeakModelAdvice.message: Choose {suggested} or a stronger model in {site}’s model menu, or give your request to a local coding agent. You can still create on this page.
panelCreateWeakModelAdvice.description: Create tab warning: the two ways out; {suggested} is a stronger model on the site (Argon), {site} the chat site. Creating on the page stays possible

panelCreateCheckModel.description: Create tab warning button: read the model the page shows again, after the user changed it

panelCreateStructure.message: Add how this page is built, without any of its text, so the AI writes for what’s here
panelCreateStructure.description: Create tab: label of the switch (on by default) that adds the structure of this page, without its text, to the request

panelCreateStructureShow.description: Create tab: fold that shows the exact page structure text added to the request

panelCreateStructureReading.description: Create tab: the page structure is being read from the page

panelCreateStructureUnavailable.message: This page didn’t answer. Reload it to see what’s added.
panelCreateStructureUnavailable.description: Create tab: the page did not answer when asked for its structure

panelCreateUnavailable.message: This page didn’t answer. Reload it, then try again.
panelCreateUnavailable.description: Create tab: the page's content script did not answer the request

panelCreateReviewTitle.description: Create tab: heading of the review of a plugin picked under an AI reply

panelCreateChecking.description: Create tab: the picked reply is being checked

panelCreateInstalling.description: Create tab: the reviewed plugin is being installed and turned on

panelCreateInstallNote.message: It turns on right away. Turn it off any time under Features.
panelCreateInstallNote.description: Create tab: what the install button does

panelCreateInstall.description: Create tab button: install the reviewed plugin and turn it on

panelCreateUpdate.description: Create tab button: replace the installed plugin with the reviewed version and turn it on

panelCreateRejectedHint.message: Use “Send the problems back to the AI” under the reply, and Voyager offers the fixed version when it arrives.
panelCreateRejectedHint.description: Create tab: where to send the problems of a refused plugin

panelCreateInstalledOn.description: Create tab: the plugin is installed and on. Keep {name}

panelCreateInstalledOff.message: {name} is installed but still off: the browser didn’t grant the site access it needs.
panelCreateInstalledOff.description: Create tab: installed, but the browser did not grant the site access it needs. Keep {name}

panelCreateTurnOn.description: Create tab button: try again to turn on the installed plugin

panelCreateReload.message: If an earlier version was running, reload the page to use this one.
panelCreateReload.description: Create tab: an earlier version with a native op keeps running until reload

panelCreateChangeAgain.message: Want a change? Tell the AI in this chat, and Voyager offers the new version under its reply.
panelCreateChangeAgain.description: Create tab: how to change the installed plugin again

panelCreateFoundIn.description: Create tab, after an install: where the creation is now; {features} is the Features tab name, {creations} the My creations group name

panelCreateFailed.message: Voyager couldn’t install it. Nothing was changed.
panelCreateFailed.description: Create tab: the install failed; nothing was installed

panelTabsLabel.description: Accessible name of the panel tab list

panelSearch.description: Search field and button that filter the feature rows

panelFullSettings.description: Button that opens the full Voyager settings (toolbar popup)

panelEntryGroup.description: Group label above the floating button row: ways to open Voyager on the page

panelFloatingButton.description: Row for Prompt Manager's floating button on the page

panelShortcutHint.message: Opens the panel when the button is hidden
panelShortcutHint.description: Tooltip on the shortcut key cap beside the floating button switch

panelThisPage.description: Mark beside the page's own site in the site menu

panelNotThisPage.message: {site} · Not this page, so changes aren't previewed
panelNotThisPage.description: Tooltip of the site switcher while another site is viewed; {site} is the site name

panelNoMatches.description: Shown when a feature search finds nothing

panelSupportedSites.description: Group label above the supported sites card

panelOtherWebsitesGroup.description: Label above added websites, where only Prompt Manager runs; {websites} is the popup's "Other websites" title

panelFeaturesOn_one.description: Under a supported site: how many features are on there

panelFeaturesOn_few.description: Under a supported site: how many features are on there

panelFeaturesOn_many.description: Under a supported site: how many features are on there

panelFeaturesOn_other.description: Under a supported site: how many features are on there

panelNotEnabled.description: Under a supported site Voyager cannot reach yet

panelWaitingForBrowser.description: Under a supported site while the browser's permission prompt is open

panelAllowAccess.description: Accessible name of a site's access switch; {site} is the site name

panelRemoveWebsite.description: Accessible name of the remove button of an added website; {site} is its host

panelCreationRemove.description: Accessible name of the remove button on a creation in the Features tab; {name} is the creation

panelCreationRemoveAsk.message: Remove {name} from this browser? You can’t undo this.
panelCreationRemoveAsk.description: Features tab: asked under a creation before removing it; {name} is the creation

panelRemoveCreationFailed.description: Toast: storage refused to remove a creation; {name} is the creation

panelSyncShared.description: Sync sheet row for data shared by every site

panelSyncSharedDetail.description: Sub-line under the Shared row: what it contains

panelSyncStatusSynced.description: Sync row status: cloud and this device match

panelSyncStatusNewerHere.description: Sync row status: this device has changes the cloud lacks

panelSyncStatusNewerInCloud.description: Sync row status: the cloud has changes this device lacks

panelSyncStatusToMerge.description: Sync row status after first connecting: cloud and local need a merge

panelSyncStatusSyncing.description: Sync row status and primary button while a sync runs

panelSyncStatusFailed.description: Sync row status when its state could not be read

panelSyncInCloud.description: Status of a site that is off here but has data in the cloud

panelSyncEnable.description: Button beside such a site: opens the Sites tab to turn it on

panelSyncRun_one.description: Primary button: run every pending row

panelSyncRun_few.description: Primary button: run every pending row

panelSyncRun_many.description: Primary button: run every pending row

panelSyncRun_other.description: Primary button: run every pending row

panelSyncMerge_one.description: Primary button after first connecting: merge every pending row

panelSyncMerge_few.description: Primary button after first connecting: merge every pending row

panelSyncMerge_many.description: Primary button after first connecting: merge every pending row

panelSyncMerge_other.description: Primary button after first connecting: merge every pending row

panelSyncUpToDate.description: Disabled primary button when nothing is pending

panelSyncMore.description: Accessible name of the sheet's more-actions button

panelSyncUploadAll.description: Menu item: upload every row to the cloud

panelSyncMergeAll.description: Menu item: merge every row from the cloud into this device

panelSyncRestorePrevious.description: Menu item and confirm button: put the cloud files back to their previous version

panelSyncRestoreAsk.message: Put the previous cloud version back?
panelSyncRestoreAsk.description: Inline question before restoring the previous cloud version

panelSyncDisconnect.description: Menu item: sign out of Google Drive

panelSyncDone_one.description: Toast after a sync: how many rows were synced

panelSyncDone_few.description: Toast after a sync: how many rows were synced

panelSyncDone_many.description: Toast after a sync: how many rows were synced

panelSyncDone_other.description: Toast after a sync: how many rows were synced

panelSyncRestored.description: Toast after restoring the previous cloud version

panelSyncRestoredPartial.message: Restored part of the previous version
panelSyncRestoredPartial.description: Toast when only some files had a previous version

panelSyncRestoreNone.message: No previous version in the cloud
panelSyncRestoreNone.description: Toast when the cloud has no previous version to restore

panelSyncConnectLine.message: Sync folders, prompts and settings across devices
panelSyncConnectLine.description: Line in the sheet before Google Drive is connected

panelSyncConnecting.description: Connect button while the sign-in is open

panelSyncFirstHint.message: Merges cloud and local first. Nothing is overwritten
panelSyncFirstHint.description: Hint after first connecting, above the rows

panelSyncSiteAdded.description: Toast after turning a site on: {site} is the site name

panelSyncAgo.description: Footer: when the last sync happened; {time} is a relative time such as "12 min ago"

panelSyncRowSwitch.description: Accessible name of a row's sync switch; {site} is the row name

panelSyncRestoreFailed.description: Toast: restoring the previous cloud version failed for every file

panelSyncUndonePartial.message: Undone. Items changed since were kept
panelSyncUndonePartial.description: Toast after undo when items changed since the sync were kept
